question: What is the AX-100 standard warranty period, and what shipment-based maximum applies?
expected_answer: The AX-100 standard warranty is 24 months from commissioning, capped at 30 months from shipment; it expires at whichever deadline comes first.
required_facts: AX-100; 24 months from commissioning; 30-month maximum from shipment; earlier deadline controls

question: What is the AX-200 standard warranty period, and what shipment-based maximum applies?
expected_answer: The AX-200 standard warranty is 18 months from commissioning, capped at 24 months from shipment; it expires at whichever deadline comes first.
required_facts: AX-200; 18 months from commissioning; 24-month maximum from shipment; earlier deadline controls

question: How is the standard warranty expiry date determined for either product?
expected_answer: Calculate the product's commissioning-based deadline and shipment-based maximum, then use whichever applicable deadline occurs first.
required_facts: Compare commissioning deadline with shipment maximum; earlier date controls

question: What kind of fault can be covered by the standard warranty?
expected_answer: A manufacturing defect under normal, authorized operation may be covered, subject to the warranty period and eligibility review.
required_facts: Manufacturing defect; normal, authorized operation; within applicable period; eligibility review

question: Which causes of damage are excluded from standard warranty coverage?
expected_answer: Damage caused by improper handling, unauthorized modifications, or failure to follow required maintenance instructions is excluded.
required_facts: Improper handling; unauthorized modifications; damage resulting from failure to follow required maintenance

question: Which products can receive an extended warranty, and how long is the extension?
expected_answer: Both AX-100 and AX-200 are eligible for an optional 12-month extension.
required_facts: AX-100; AX-200; optional; 12 months

question: When must an extended warranty be purchased and registered?
expected_answer: Both purchase and registration must be completed before the standard warranty expires.
required_facts: Purchase before standard expiry; registration before standard expiry

question: What information should a reporter provide to open a service request?
expected_answer: Provide the product model, serial number, fault description, relevant warranty records, relevant service or maintenance information, and reporter contact details.
required_facts: Model; serial number; fault description; relevant warranty records; relevant service and maintenance information; contact details

question: An AX-100 shipped on 2026-01-01 and commissioned on 2027-01-01. Which date is earlier: 24 months after commissioning or 30 months after shipment, and when does standard coverage expire?
expected_answer: The deadlines are 2029-01-01 from commissioning and 2028-07-01 from shipment. The earlier deadline is 2028-07-01, so that is the standard warranty expiry date.
required_facts: AX-100; shipment 2026-01-01; commissioning 2027-01-01; 24-month date 2029-01-01; 30-month date 2028-07-01; earlier deadline

question: An AX-200 shipped on 2026-03-01 and commissioned on 2026-11-01. Which date is earlier: 18 months after commissioning or 24 months after shipment, and when does standard coverage expire?
expected_answer: The deadlines are 2028-05-01 from commissioning and 2028-03-01 from shipment. The earlier deadline is 2028-03-01, so that is the standard warranty expiry date.
required_facts: AX-200; shipment 2026-03-01; commissioning 2026-11-01; 18-month date 2028-05-01; 24-month date 2028-03-01; earlier deadline

question: An AX-100 fault arose during its standard warranty period, but the damage was caused by an unauthorized modification. Is that damage covered by the standard warranty?
expected_answer: No. Damage caused by an unauthorized modification is excluded, even if it arose during the standard warranty period.
required_facts: Damage caused by unauthorized modification; exclusion applies during standard warranty

question: An AX-200 standard warranty has already expired when the owner purchases and registers the optional extension. Does the extension meet the timing requirement?
expected_answer: No. The extension must be both purchased and registered before standard warranty expiry; doing so after expiry does not meet the requirement.
required_facts: Purchase after standard expiry; registration after standard expiry; both must occur before expiry

question: A confirmed AX-100 manufacturing defect occurred within its standard coverage period under normal, authorized operation. Which documents govern coverage review, what information should be submitted, and may a warranty repair begin before authorization?
expected_answer: AST-WAR-001 governs the covered fault and standard period. Submit the model, serial number, fault description, relevant warranty records, and relevant service or maintenance information under AST-SVC-001. The repair must not begin as an authorized warranty repair until the service team authorizes it.
required_facts: AX-100; confirmed manufacturing defect; normal authorized operation; within standard period; service request contents; prior repair authorization

question: An AX-200 is within a properly registered extended warranty, but its damage resulted from failure to follow required maintenance instructions. Is that damage covered, and how should a claim be submitted?
expected_answer: No. The extension keeps the standard warranty's exclusion for damage resulting from failure to follow required maintenance instructions. A claim should follow AST-SVC-001: provide the model, serial number, fault description, relevant warranty records, and related maintenance information for review.
required_facts: AX-200; extension properly registered; damage caused by failure to follow required maintenance; same exclusions apply; standard request details

question: The shipment date for a unit is missing and its commissioning date conflicts across records. What must be established to assess standard expiry, and what should happen to the service request while those facts remain unresolved?
expected_answer: AST-WAR-001 requires the model, shipment date, and commissioning date to determine the earlier applicable deadline. Under AST-SVC-001, the reporter should provide available records, the service team should request clarification, and the request remains unresolved for eligibility purposes until the gap is addressed; it may be escalated.
required_facts: Product model; verified shipment and commissioning dates; compare the two deadlines; request clarification; unresolved eligibility; escalation

question: An AX-100 has a timely purchased and registered extension, and a manufacturing defect under normal, authorized operation is reported during the extension period. Which coverage terms apply, what should the claim include, and what must happen before warranty repair?
expected_answer: AST-EW-001 extends the same manufacturing-defect coverage for 12 months after standard coverage, with the same exclusions. Submit the model, serial number, fault description, and relevant warranty records, including extension purchase and registration details, under AST-SVC-001. The service team must authorize the warranty repair before it begins.
required_facts: AX-100; extension purchased and registered before standard expiry; 12-month extension; defect during extension; normal authorized operation; request data; prior authorization

question: What guaranteed response time does Asteron promise after a service request is opened?
expected_answer: The supplied documents do not establish a guaranteed response time. AST-SVC-001 §§3–7 describe submission, review, and follow-up but give no response-time commitment.
required_facts: No guaranteed response-time duration is stated

question: Will Asteron provide an on-site technician at no charge for an AX-200 fault?
expected_answer: The supplied documents do not establish whether on-site service is available or whether it is free. AST-SVC-001 §§2–7 describe reporting and review but do not specify service location or fees.
required_facts: On-site service availability not stated; service fee not stated
source_sections: AST-SVC-001 §§2–7 (no service-location or fee terms stated)

question: What is the maximum amount Asteron reimburses for customer-paid repair costs?
expected_answer: The supplied documents do not state a reimbursement amount or reimbursement cap, so it cannot be determined from this policy set.
required_facts: No repair reimbursement amount or cap is stated

question: Can the warranty be transferred to a later owner if the equipment is sold?
expected_answer: The supplied documents do not establish whether warranty coverage is transferable to a later owner.
required_facts: Warranty transferability is not stated
